name: 421-a(16) Affordable New York Housing Program Completion Extension - Letters of Intent
description:
This dataset contains 740 records of Letters of Intent submitted under the 421-a(16) Affordable New York Housing Program completion extension. Each record captures a developer's reported project details, including submission date, property addresses, borough, Department of Buildings (DOB) identification numbers, unit counts (total and affordable), commencement and anticipated completion dates, tax block and lot, and the selected affordability option. It also includes presumed or derived fields such as community board, council district, building unit and affordable unit estimates, duplicate flags, and geographic identifiers like postcode, latitude, longitude, BBL, census tract, and neighborhood tabulation area.

The data can be used to track and map affordable housing projects seeking the 421-a completion extension, analyze the geographic distribution of applications across boroughs and neighborhoods, compare reported versus presumed unit counts, identify potential duplicate submissions, and study affordability options and project timelines. It is useful for housing policy research, urban planning analysis, and public transparency around affordable housing development.
